scope: Approved local test-fixture corrections and constrained Linux regression; not a production release
changes: Synthetic OIDC issuer strictly decodes OAuth Basic form-encoded credentials and compares the expected test client and secret
Foreign workspace keeps its independent human owner and receives no Agent grant for the original user
Packaged disabled-authority regression expects owner-readable availability while continuing to reject grant creation and revocation

redEvidence.oidc: Earlier callback regression failed with 401 at the fixture's raw Basic comparison
redEvidence.foreignWorkspace: Normal-mode reproduction failed with not_found while attempting original-user membership in the foreign workspace
redEvidence.disabledAvailability: Earlier packaged regression expected 404 while the approved availability route returned 200

smoke.coverage: Real HTTP/WebSocket, two mock model backends in one channel, SQLite restart persistence, private bind and config preservation

independentReview.result: No concrete bugs or weakened security assertions found in the scoped delta
independentReview.method: Read-only static review; not an additional test run

acceptanceLimits: Related regression only; the full repository suite has not been rerun on this exact snapshot
OIDC issuer responses are synthetic and cookies are manually supplied over local HTTP
Real Pocket ID interoperability and browser cookie enforcement remain separate acceptance gates
Muse and dots external Agent round trips have not been accepted
No production deployment, credential changes, client grants or Relay modifications in this phase
Protected-service baseline comparison does not establish Relay traffic performance
Ignored raw evidence paths are local reproducibility references and are not shipped as repository artifacts
